runtimeGitPolicy: Git-history reconstruction was reviewed and committed as audit evidence. Runtime does not execute Git subprocesses to reverify blob identity.

claims.claim: estimateRealizedVolatility uses lookbackBars=10 (ten log returns / lookbackBars+1 closes) for mispricing and frozen calibration-fade volatility.
claims.summary: Shared estimator requires lookbackBars closes for returns; atlas DEFAULT_MISPRICING_VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK_BARS and frozen volatilityDefinition.lookbackBars are both 10.

claims.claim: Volatility method is realized log-return annualized via estimateRealizedVolatility.
claims.summary: Log returns of closes, stableStdDev, annualized by inferred bar interval (else 60s).

claims.claim: Mispricing atlas attaches annualizedVolatility via enrichResearchObservationFeatures from research-output candles parsed by parseMispricingObservations.
claims.summary: Discovery path uses pre-built candles already present in research-output, not capture btc-spot ticks.
limitations: Exact upstream candle provider and gap policy for research-output candles are outside the atlas feature path.

claims.claim: parseMispricingObservations prefers engineInput.btc.candles then falls back to snapshot.btcBars.
claims.summary: Confirms atlas candle ingress; no adjacent-source-gap enforcement in this mapper.
limitations: Does not uniquely identify which historical discovery runs used candles versus btcBars.

claims.summary: Bucket definition minInclusive 0.6 with maxExclusive null.

claims.summary: Causal cutoff, minute buckets, in-progress minute included; missing minutes omitted without fill; no maximumSourceGapMs parameter.
limitations: This freeze-forward candle path differs from the atlas discovery candle ingress, so a single historical source contract is not uniquely established.
